model_config.host_context: Shared macOS arm64 host; no CPU isolation. Local validation ran concurrently during initial samples; contention was not measured.

plan.context: fixed scalar and nonconstant stacked matrices plus signed/tie/zero/parameter boundaries; no prompt or generated token context
plan.memory: native simultaneous malloc request payloads and Python-managed allocations; each complete worker RSS separate; tracer/runtime overhead retained
plan.sampling: fixed order; fresh native and Python workers; no warmup, retry or discarded sample
plan.scope: bounded RFC-0024 operation; all bindings on; no inference/profile/privacy/W8 credit
plan.timing: instrumented resource observations, not uninstrumented performance or fitted constants

note: Complete bounded RFC-0024 resource matrix with all bindings enabled. Instrumented native phases and independent closed-request timings retain profiler overhead; no uninstrumented performance comparison or fitted constant. Capture and advice generation are separate stages and sum to witness_recompute_ns. Native simultaneous malloc requests, Python-managed allocations and both whole-worker RSS values have separate scopes. Native process wall includes allocation-collection pause. Component bytes, Usage and continuations remain in samples/raw artifacts; no inference, privacy, profile, W8 or control-count credit. Standard is the ledger schema tag only.
